audit.summary: Exact square tableau endpoint counterexample also disproves uniform kernel convergence used in Theorem5 proof. Two separate local defects concern countable events and a degenerate L-shape boundary.
limitations: P1 — Counterevidence: Interior liquid analysis not contradicted. Extreme bead integrated normalized mass1/n vanishes. Square limiting density integrates to(2/pi)asin(sqrt(t)) and1 at t=1; global height formula not disproved.

P2 — Counterevidence: Finite cylinder combinations and correct continuity-event portmanteau theorem hold. Corollary19 proof pp352-353 uses Skorohod coupling and finite random cutoff; no core use of false extension established.
P3 — Counterevidence: Genuine L-shape interpretation would exclude the point, but that is a stricter domain than printed. Nondegenerate theorem not refuted.
Limitations: All56pages read, not all contour estimates independently certified
Limitations: External existence and height-concentration theorems not reproved
Limitations: No claimed general repaired Theorem5 proof
Limitations: Bounded correction search not proof of absence
Limitations: No author code or simulation used as proof

proposition.claim:
Theorem16 frozen local limit is empty also at t0=0,1; the proof of Theorem5 asserts uniform kernel convergence on compact sets of the whole closed parameter rectangle to justify integration.

lambda0=(1),lambdaN=n by n square,N=n^2,eta=1. a0=-1,b1=0,a1=1. Uniform normalized Lebesgue law on order polytope. x0=0,t0=1; arithmetic condition x0*sqrt(|lambda0|) integer holds.

Proposition22 gives convergence of probabilities for arbitrary countable Boolean combinations of continuity-set cylinders.

Deterministic locally finite counting measures on Z x R. nu_n=delta_(0,1/n) weakly converges to nu=delta_(0,0). B_k={0}x(1/k,2), bounded nu-continuity sets.

Proposition11 parameter domain includes q<=min(p+2,2r-p) while Eq20 and proof require strict interlacing.

Rational p=1/2,q=3/2,r=1 belongs to displayed domain.

repair.content:
Remove time endpoints from bulk local-limit statement or prove distinct endpoint result. Replace false uniformity in Theorem5 proof with endpoint/critical-time control, e.g. a justified cumulative-height or uniform-integrability argument.

Use finite Boolean combinations or require A to be continuity event for limiting law.

Use strict q upper bound for genuine L-shapes and separate degenerate rectangles.
